Game Overview

Ice Block Puzzle is a block game built around navigate a frosty world as you slide ice blocks across a bustling 6x6 grid to liberate a solitary icy blue block. Each strategic move tests your logic. Relish a challenging yet soothing atmosphere where every swipe brings you closer to mastering the art of puzzle-solving perfection.
